title: Hotels with a Mount Fuji view: which room to book
metaDescription: Five hotels by Lake Kawaguchi with rooms sold as Mount Fuji view or mountain view, the exact room category to book, and the garden and lake rooms to skip.
h1: Hotels with a Mount Fuji view, and which room to book
dek: Five hotels in Fujikawaguchiko, the town on Lake Kawaguchi. For each one we list the exact room category sold with the view, and the garden and lake view rooms that look the other way.
teaser: From a hotel with the view in every room name to one where the lake side is the other side.

decoder.text: At the Fuji View Hotel, the Moderate Twin Room and the Moderate Japanese-Style Room are each sold two ways. “Fuji View” is in the hotel's name, but only the room with “Mt.Fuji View” in its name comes with the mountain.

At Fujikawaguchiko Onsen Konansou, the same kinds of room are sold with a lake view or a mountain view. Travels With Elle says some rooms face Mount Fuji and others face the lake, without naming categories.
The Oike Hotel sells one room under the name “Business Small Double Room, No Mt. Fuji View”. The five categories we recommend there carry the view in the name.

alternatives.title: The view from the bath
alternatives.text: At some Lake Kawaguchi hotels the Fuji view is from a bath or a terrace, not from the room. Kawaguchiko.net names the hot spring baths at the Tominoko Hotel and the observatory and baths at Wakakusa no Yado Maruei Ryokan.

faq.q: Which hotels in Fujikawaguchiko sell rooms with a Mount Fuji view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026: Hotel Regina Kawaguchiko, Hotel Mifujien, Fuji View Hotel and Oike Hotel sell categories with Mt. Fuji in the name. Fujikawaguchiko Onsen Konansou sells mountain view categories, but its sources don't agree on which rooms face the mountain.

faq.q: Does a hotel called “Fuji View” put every room facing the mountain?
faq.a: No. The Fuji View Hotel sells some of its rooms with a garden view. Book a category with “Mt.Fuji View” in the name.

faq.q: Which hotel has the most Mount Fuji view room types?
faq.a: Hotel Regina Kawaguchiko, with 16 on Expedia: eight room types, each in two versions, all with Mt. Fuji View in the name.

faq.q: Can any room promise a clear view of Mount Fuji?
faq.a: No room can promise a clear day. The mountain is often hidden by cloud, so the category name tells you which way the room faces, not whether you will see the summit.
